conviction_note: Confirmed bmo Q3 announcement (07:00 CEST 15 Oct). It carries operating KPIs only, and Coller's FAUM is already public. The undisclosed lines are EQT XI activation, Q3 inflows, exits and key-fund valuations, and nothing found settles any of them. Three small positive proxies (sell-side targets trimmed into the print, flat-to-up Q3 listed markets, an active Q3 exit tape) roughly offset the risk of a third slip in EQT XI activation, so p_up 54 on abs 5.0 gives +0.4, close to the findings' +0.5 sum. The two numbers agree because neither rests on a company number the market has not seen.

findings.finding: EQT XI activation has slipped twice, from 'H1 2026' (Q3 2025 announcement) to 'around mid-year 2026' (Q1 2026) to 'towards the end of Q3' (H1 report, with only half the EUR 23bn target secured). No first-close or activation release appeared on the Nasdaq Nordic feed, MFN or EQT's newsroom through 14 Oct, so the Q3 announcement is where the market learns whether the flagship activated, and at what size.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Fundraising lines drive EQT's prints: the H1 2026 report (BPEA IX hard cap, Infra VII target, AI infra FAUM) moved +11.0% on 2026-07-17. On the Q3 2025 announcement, where the EQT XI activation date was set, the stock fell 2.9% (2025-10-16, Yahoo bars).
findings.why_not_priced: The activation status is not public, and no wire or trade-press item reports a first close (searched 14 Oct). If the market expected a third slip, the 20-day run-up would be worse than -5.1% against a peer group already down 22-24% since mid-August, and the short register would be building rather than flat. Neither is the case. The sign is genuinely open, hence the wide range and the small central size: activation on time lands inside guidance and is worth about 0.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 timing ('first close and activation around mid-year 2026'): https://tools.prnewswire.com/en-us/live/20813/release/20260422EN40783. Q3 2025 timing ('expected to be activated in H1 2026'): https://tools.prnewswire.com/en-us/live/20823/release/20251016EN99622

findings.finding: Sell-side lowered the bar into the print: Goldman Sachs (445->430) and BNP Paribas (425->410) on 1 Oct, and DNB Carnegie (370->365) on 5 Oct, all keeping buy ratings, with the stock at ~283-288 SEK, down ~17% from its mid-August level.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Citi put EQT on negative catalyst watch before the H1 2026 print and the stock rose 11% on the day (efn.se, snippet). A lowered or worried bar has preceded positive reactions here once. One instance only.
findings.original_quote: Goldman Sachs sänker riktkursen för EQT till 430 kronor (445), upprepar köp / BNP Paribas sänker riktkursen för EQT till 410 kronor (425), upprepar outperform (Goldman Sachs cuts EQT's target price to SEK 430 from 445, reiterates buy / BNP Paribas cuts it to SEK 410 from 425, reiterates outperform)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the trims are public wire items, and the stock already fell with them. What is not priced is that the estimate cuts behind those targets lower the FAUM and inflow bar a released number has to clear. That is an inference, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: Listed markets rose over Q3 2026: S&P 500 +2.0% and OMX Stockholm +2.1% from 30 Jun to 30 Sep (Yahoo daily bars), against a Q1 in which EQT said earlier vintages were hit by lower listed share prices and reference multiples. That supports a flat-to-positive Q3 key-fund valuation line, with infrastructure uplifts continuing as reported in H1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2026 key-fund valuations +5% coincided with the +11% day. Q1 2026 valuations, flat on average, coincided with +0.8% (2026-04-22).
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission, so only a hypothesis. The valuation line is unpublished, and the alt-manager complex (BX -24%, KKR -24%, CVC -22%, Partners Group -16% since 14 Aug, against flat indices) is priced for private-mark stress rather than for a benign Q3 mark. A priced benign mark would show EQT's drawdown tracking the index, not the peer group.
findings.independence: EQT's own H1 commentary on infrastructure double-digit uplifts and 14% EBITDA growth in Private Capital: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b06955ecd1cb52bdfec2869538b1ba668&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: Q3 exit tape was active: the Beijer Ref remaining-stake exit (July), sales of Ontinue (16 Sep) and Acuon (30 Sep), and US logistics portfolio sales by EQT Real Estate. Q3 2025 printed only EUR 2bn of gross fund exits.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Exits and capital returned led the H1 2026 narrative ('sent back close to EUR 17bn'), on a +11% day. The 'significant decline in exit activity' warning in Q1 2025 was a negative headline (aktiespararna, snippet).
findings.why_not_priced: Each sale was announced separately and is public. The quarterly gross-exit aggregate, and whether signed exits count in Q3, is not. A small size reflects that most of the money is already visible.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 baseline of EUR 2bn gross fund exits: https://tools.prnewswire.com/en-us/live/20823/release/20251016EN99622
